screens.name: Opening screen
screens.purpose: Signed-out opening screen: the promise "Plan. Focus. Achieve.", the "Sign in or create an account" button that opens the hosted sign-in page, and the "You're signed out." message after signing out

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: The dashboard: three summary cards, the Add New Task card, and the task list with All/Pending/Completed tabs, per-task check, Edit and trash actions, and Clear All with its confirmation

screens.name: Statistics
screens.purpose: The person's live task numbers: Total tasks, Completed and Pending cards, and the green completed-share bar with its "2 of 5 tasks done" line

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: The signed-in person's own name, email address and "Member since" line, with the Sign out button

screens.name: Compact header with a menu on phones
screens.purpose: Where Move around on a phone lives: Compact header with a menu on phones.

parts.name: Sidebar
parts.purpose: Fixed left sidebar on wide screens with the logo, Home, Statistics and Settings, a small checklist illustration and the line "Plan. Focus. Achieve."

parts.name: Header
parts.purpose: Top bar with the logo, the menu button on phones that opens Home, Statistics and Settings, the colour-mode switch and the account menu holding Settings and Sign out
